senses.gloss:
उत्तुंग^1 a.
1 Lofty, high, tall;
करप्रचेयामुत्तुगः प्रभुशक्तिं प्रथीयसीं
Śi. 2. 89; ˚हेमपीठानि 2. 5.
--2 Swollen,
increased (as a stream).
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170110. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/332,. note: (checked by the source of the quotation - ed. 1815).

उत्तुंडितं The head of a thorn
(which enters the skin).

उत्तुल् {c10c} P.
1 To raise up (by
means of a balance).
--2 To raise,
erect, lift up.
--3 To weigh.

उत्तुषः [उद्गतः तुषोऽस्मात्] ‘Freed
from husks’, fried grain.
